servicingRequirement_MagnusonMoss.fact: A manufacturer cannot void a warranty or deny coverage because maintenance or repair was done by an independent shop, by the owner, or with third-party parts, unless it provides that service or part free. It may deny a claim only if it shows the outside part or work caused the defect. Owners should follow the maintenance schedule and keep dated receipts.
servicingRequirement_MagnusonMoss.law: Magnuson-Moss Warranty Act, enforced by the FTC
servicingRequirement_MagnusonMoss.note: FTC consumer page URL tried (consumer.ftc.gov/articles/auto-warranties-routine-maintenance) returned 404.

servicingRequirement_BlockExemption.fact: Under the Block Exemption Regulation (retained in UK after Brexit) a manufacturer cannot void the warranty solely because an independent garage serviced the car, provided servicing follows the manufacturer schedule, uses genuine or matching-quality parts, and is recorded. Service-activated extensions (Toyota Relax, Honda, Nissan) are separate: they require a franchised service to extend.

usedCarKeepsWarranty.summary: Generally yes: factory warranties attach to the car (VIN) and the remaining time/distance passes to the next owner. Exceptions found: Hyundai and Kia US 10yr/100k powertrain is original-owner only (reverts to 5yr/60k for later owners); Ram 2026 10yr/100k powertrain is original-owner only. UK: Kia, MG, Hyundai, Honda (service-activated) all stated transferable. Service-activated extensions require the service condition to keep running.

usualCollisionDeductible.value: $500 is the most common; $500 and $1,000 are the usual choices. Raising from $500 to $1,000 cuts collision+comprehensive premium 10-25%.

liabilityOnlyCoversOwnCar.fact: Liability pays for injuries to others and damage to others' property; it does not pay for damage to the policyholder's own car. Own-car damage needs collision (crash) or comprehensive (theft, weather, animal, etc.).

claimFrequency.value: Overall claims frequency 11.9% in 2023 (12.8% in 2019), across major insurers, all claim types
claimFrequency.note: Not split by own-damage vs third-party property

thirdPartyOnlyCoversOwnCar.note: UK Third Party Only and Third Party Fire & Theft do not pay for accidental damage to the policyholder's own car; only Comprehensive does. Standard product definitions; no specific page fetched.

nationalRepairableSeverity.value: Average repairable claim about CAD 5,044 in H1 2023 (+12% y/y); total losses about 1 in 5 physical damage claims; body labour CAD 75/hr

ownCarNuance.Ontario: Direct Compensation - Property Damage (DCPD) pays for the policyholder's own car to the extent they are not at fault (Ontario crash, identified insured other vehicle). Optional since 1 Jan 2024 via OPCF 49; waiving DCPD also waives collision.
ownCarNuance.BC: ICBC Basic Vehicle Damage Coverage pays the policyholder's own repairs up to CAD 200,000 to the extent they are not responsible; not for single-vehicle crashes, hit-and-runs or crashes outside BC. At-fault own-car damage needs optional Collision.

lenderRequirement_US.fact: Not a state law; it is a loan/lease contract term. Lenders and lessors require comprehensive and collision until the loan is paid off, commonly with a maximum deductible of $500-$1,000; lessors often also require gap. If coverage lapses the lender can force-place collateral protection insurance, which protects only the lender's interest and costs much more (one source: about 2-3x).

MX_CDMX.requirement: Vehicles must carry current civil-liability (responsabilidad civil) insurance from a CNSF-authorised insurer covering third-party persons and property (CDMX Reglamento de Tránsito). Federal roads (since 2019, Ley de Caminos, Puentes y Autotransporte Federal): minimum MXN 50,000 property damage and MXN 100,000 bodily injury/death. Fine in CDMX for no insurance: 20-40 UMA (about MXN 2,262.80-4,525.60 in 2026).

US.fact: If the insured cancels, some insurers refund on a short-rate basis (keep about 10% of the unearned premium more than pro-rata) where their filed rates allow; insurer-initiated cancellation is pro-rata. NY: short-rate penalty allowed only if in the insurer's filed rates and the policy is not premium-financed (opinion is about a commercial package policy).
US.CAnote: The CA code section in the search result (Ins. Code §10369.9) concerns disability insurance, not auto; not used.

ON.fact: Ontario standard policy OAP 1: if the insured cancels, premium is calculated on a short-rate basis including handling costs; each insurer files its own short-rate table

BC.fact: ICBC cancellation fee CAD 30 (plus CAD 18 re-plating; CAD 15 if paying monthly), per 2019-2020 reporting

MX.fact: On cancellation the insured is entitled to refund of unearned premium (primas no devengadas), typically within 15-30 business days; if cancelled within the first 30 days the first full month is kept; the policy issuance fee (derecho de póliza) is not refunded
